issue.title: Delete document API causes index-creation

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
I've recently stumbled upon that ES might create an index if there is a delete request for a document in it and the index does not exist. To me this seems veeeery weird. Anyone that can explain why and whether I can disable this?

```[2016-11-23 12:07:48,532][INFO ][cluster.metadata         ] [xxx-node] [xxx-2016.03] creating index, cause [auto(delete api)], templates [template.xxx], shards [2]/[1], mappings [_default_]```
